name: [FPS] Recoil
desc:
Welcome to Recoil.

Recoil is a fast-paced FPS arena where skill matters most. Use different weapons from snipers to automatic rifles and dominate the arena!🎯

🔫 Snipers, ARs, SMGs, Shotguns & more
⚡ Fast respawns
🌀 Slide, reposition, and outmaneuver!
🔥 Killstreaks
🎨 90+ weapon skins to unlock
📦 Open cases for rare cosmetics
🏆 Climb ranks and prove your skill

No teams, just pure FFA chaos.

🎮 Available on PC, Mobile, Tablet & Console
(Xbox & PlayStation supported)

👍 Like the game if you enjoy playing, it helps a lot!

⚠️ Cheating, exploiting, or abusing alts will result in permanent ban with no appeal.

Made by the creators of [FPS] One Tap.
